goal: Deliver the smallest complete CGKN v0.3 artifact-driven vertical slice with typed feed-forward, deterministic local recompute, stale-aware delivery, reference evidence, and backward compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact-driven compiler and runtime validate typed producers, projections, implementations, freshness, output schemas, cache fingerprints, and effect cardinality.
ArtifactInstance, ArtifactRef, ArtifactStore, deterministic hashes, provenance, version history, index, lineage, and structural diff are implemented and tested.
Existing flows and the reviewed Provider, evidence, packaging, and delivery authorities remain unchanged; targeted and full regression profiles pass.
Stale required artifacts block final delivery judgment and checkpoints contain execution metadata plus artifact refs rather than business payloads.
The reference project-refactor flow produces a complete local sample run and demonstrates affected-only recompute with the project snapshot reused.

quality_metrics.measure: management artifacts conform to registered JSON schemas and semantic invariants
quality_metrics.target: all management, iteration, and experience artifacts validate
quality_metrics.method: jsonschema tests plus deterministic manager validation

quality_metrics.measure: cross-view consistency and safe downstream publication during real project generation
quality_metrics.target: 100% of generated and reused components have hash-valid plan/quality/interface/upstream receipts before publication, only passing bounded projections feed downstream, and one aggregate receipt exists before post-build
quality_metrics.method: deterministic positive and negative receipt tests, component-loop integration test, artifact/event-log inspection, and kernel authority guard

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

feedback: The artifact-driven vertical slice meets its scoped contracts and reference demonstration; repository-wide full_all remains unaccepted because unrelated baseline failures and a timeout prevent an all-tests-pass claim.

worked: The Todo mutation demonstrated affected-only recompute and unchanged snapshot reuse.
Typed artifact boundaries, deterministic cache/invalidation, and support-only delivery authority stayed isolated and were directly testable.
did_not_work: The pre-existing dirty branch could not produce a green full_all profile within 1200 seconds and contains unrelated Provider/Codex/benchmark failures.
experiments: Capture a clean committed-checkout baseline profile before the next non-trivial kernel increment and compare identical post-commit evidence.
